Class StagedContentRegistry

java.lang.Object
org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.fhir.streaming.StagedContentRegistry
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable
public final class StagedContentRegistry extends Object implements Closeable
Holds the document content that has been split out of a FHIR request body before the body was handed to the FHIR parser, for the duration of one request.

For every extracted document the registry mints a short marker: a few dozen bytes that take the place of the original content in the slimmed-down request body. The marker is valid base64 content, so the FHIR parser accepts it as an ordinary base64Binary value and it survives resource copying and reordering unchanged — it simply travels with the resource as its data. When the MHD-to-XDS translator finally needs the document it hands the parsed data back here via resolve(byte[]) and gets the streamed content instead.

The registry is put on the servlet request under REQUEST_ATTRIBUTE and owns temporary files, so it must be closed once the request has been processed.

    • forParameters

      public static Optional<StagedContentRegistry> forParameters(Map<String,Object> parameters)
      Looks up the registry from the parameter map that a FHIR resource provider hands to a translator or route, which is where a consumer of the parsed resource normally starts from. Equivalent to forRequest(ServletRequest) on the servlet request behind Constants.FHIR_REQUEST_DETAILS.
      Parameters:
      parameters - parameter map of the FHIR request, may be null
      Returns:
      the registry of that request, or empty if its body was not split, if the request did not arrive through a servlet, or if the parameters do not carry any request details at all
